name: Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg
short_description: Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at SM Seaside Cebu in Cebu City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: The Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg is organised by RSRJ Events Management and is held at SM Seaside Cebu in Cebu City, per the Pinoy Fitness listing. It offers 5 km, 10 km and 21 km categories. The registration form asks entrants about the Davao and Manila legs of the same series, so the Cebu race is one leg of a multi-city Sagisag series.

faqs.question: When and where is race kit claiming for the Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: The registration page lists two claiming windows at the event venue. The first is on the pre-race day, 3 October 2026, from 3:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and the second is on race day, 4 October 2026, from 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to enter the Sagisag Half Marathon 2026 Cebu Leg?
faqs.answer: The registration page lists the 21K at PHP 1,700-1,800, the 10K at PHP 1,400-1,500 and the 5K at PHP 1,150-1,250, with a web admin fee on top. All categories include a singlet, an RFID race bib, a finisher medal and a finisher towel, and the 10K and 21K also include a finisher shirt.
